node: Student-loan servicing, education payments, communications, and compliance systems
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion found a concentrated set of US-listed companies directly tied to regulated education payment and servicing workflows. Nelnet is the cleanest reference anchor because it combines student-loan servicing systems with education technology and payments. Flywire is a higher-education payments and student financial software platform. Paymentus and Blackbaud are underfollowed discovery-lane candidates because their education payment exposure is embedded inside broader billing, payments, nonprofit, or K-12 software categories rather than simple edtech screens. Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around regulated servicing infrastructure, education payments, borrower communications, collections workflows, and compliance-heavy operating systems. The strongest direct public-market mappings are Nelnet for student-loan servicing plus education payments, Flywire for education payment infrastructure, Maximus for outsourced federal student-loan servicing operations, and Navient as a speculative shadow candidate because it retains student-loan assets and historical servicing/compliance exposure but has materially reduced or exited direct federal servicing exposure. This pass intentionally emphasizes underfollowed infrastructure and regulated workflow providers rather than obvious schools or edtech brands. Expanded the underfollowed public-company universe for the regulated student-loan servicing and education-payments workflow node. The strongest direct public exposure is Nelnet, with explicit Loan Servicing and Systems plus Education Technology Services and Payme
